speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me more about the onset of the swelling and pain in your right ring finger? Did it start suddenly or gradually, and have you noticed any changes in color or temperature in that area?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you hear or feel a "pop" at the moment of injury, and are you able to fully bend and straighten the finger? I also need to know if there is any significant bruising or deformity visible on the finger.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: This clinical picture is highly suggestive of a mallet finger injury, which is an avulsion of the extensor tendon or a fracture at the distal phalanx. REQUEST TEST: X-ray_right_ring_finger
